## Observed hosted failure
On PR #150 head `7e93b764b4796c42224419337750a85a48996506`, [CI run 40168402212, Node 22 job 121094064800](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/40168402212/job/121094064800) fails the full npm release gate. Runtime is Node 22.23.3. The suite reports 1,923 tests, 1,922 passes and one failure:

`test/annotate.test.ts:315`, “PM provenance stays absent without a matching recorded event, and unsafe item links cannot open paths”: `failureType: hookFailed`, `code: ENOTEMPTY`, removing a synthetic temporary directory's `.pm-cli/locks`.

This is a hosted CI observation, not a locally reproduced product bug. The log's original temporary basename is omitted because it is irrelevant to reproduction. The changed pack-reader regression passes, and all coverage dimensions are 100%. No attribution assertion failure, pack corruption, or user-data loss is demonstrated.

## Source and expected behavior
[Annotation fixture teardown](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7e93b764b4796c42224419337750a85a48996506/test/annotate.test.ts#L25) calls every owned directory's cleanup after the test. [makeTempDir cleanup](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7e93b764b4796c42224419337750a85a48996506/test/helpers/tmp.ts#L25-L28) calls synchronous recursive removal with force, without explicit lifecycle coordination in this helper.

Expected: test-owned PM activity is settled and its isolated fixture is safely disposed of, without a cleanup-only failure making the release verdict unreliable. Actual: cleanup encounters a nonempty lock directory and fails the gate. The exact writer/lifecycle cause is unproven; a concurrent writer is a hypothesis, not an established root cause.

## Impact and evidence boundaries
The failed Node22 npm gate skips its full Bun gate and Bun install verification, so the final receipt-only head lacks clean exact-head release evidence. Node26's full test job and Windows22/26 launcher checks now pass (final refresh06:41 UTC). PR150 attributes clean four-gate evidence to prior implementation head ac10c2bef2821807ee5c92c1d57d4be3bd74df5b, not this final head.

No local concurrency reproduction, production mutation, workflow rerun, or implementation change was performed for this report. Reproduction evidence is the linked existing hosted run executing npm run release:check with the committed suite. This does not establish a new pack regression.

## Acceptance / regression protection
- Identify and settle the test-owned PM client/background lifecycle before deleting its fixture, or otherwise make teardown safely robust to the observed transient nonempty directory without hiding persistent cleanup failures.
- Add a focused lifecycle/cleanup regression with explicit ownership and retained failures, rather than weakening provenance assertions, skipping the test, or lowering coverage gates.
- Record a clean exact-head Node22 release gate and the previously skipped Bun checks. Preserve complete assertions and100% coverage requirements.
- Retain no claim of whole-release certification until all required final-head gates succeed.

## Existing ownership checked
All150 all-status issue/PR entries were fetched in two pages; no matching cleanup issue found. All-status search for cleanup and ENOTEMPTY found none. PR150 conversation/inline/reviews contain no existing cleanup-hook owner. [Annotation feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7e93b764b4796c42224419337750a85a48996506/.agents/pm/features/pm-vcs-p7annotate.toon) is closed and does not record this failure. [Current pack feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7e93b764b4796c42224419337750a85a48996506/.agents/pm/features/pm-vcs-phase6packs.toon) records earlier green implementation-head evidence and pending final-head validation. [Certification chore](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7e93b764b4796c42224419337750a85a48996506/.agents/pm/chores/pm-vcs-bcgs.toon) is blocked on separate exact-head/PR dispatch evidence, not this cleanup failure. No PM item link for this specific new defect is invented.
